name: Numerical Techniques in Biophysical Modeling
description: Numerical differentiation and integration; error analysis, convergence and stability of numerical methods; ODEs in biophysical systems – predator prey models, tissue viscoelasticity; explicit and implicit time-stepping methods – forward/backward Euler, BDF; PDEs – diffusive mass transfer, Turing pattern formation via reaction-diffusion, spatial segregation of proteins using finite difference methods; finite element method (FEM) – weak formulation, convergence, mesh sensitivity, comparison with FDM; PDEs in solid mechanics – linear elastic, viscoelastic (1D/2D), hyperelastic materials (demonstrations); PDEs in fluid mechanics - Newtonian (air/urine) and non-Newtonian (blood); simulation and visualization using python and COMSOL.
